english.note: This is the all-purpose choice for expressing an extremely or intensely strong reaction.
This is the all-purpose choice for saying that something is exceptionally or unusually intense.
This is the all-purpose choice for saying that something happens or is the case to an extraordinary degree.
Use this for a strong degree in a somewhat more emphatic or formal-sounding expression than 好.
This is the all-purpose choice for saying that something is extraordinarily or amazingly intense.
Use this for a clear, strong degree equivalent to “very much” or “extremely.”
Use this for a straightforward, slightly more neutral or emphatic equivalent of “extremely” across many contexts.
Use this when “radically” is being used to mean “very” or to mark a high degree.
Use this neutral, slightly more formal-sounding choice when modifying a feeling, evaluation, or amount to mean ‘extremely’.
Choose this for a stronger and somewhat more formal or deliberate statement than 好.
Use 非常 as a more formal alternative to 好 for expressing a high degree.
Use 非常 for a more emphatic or formal-sounding ‘very’ or ‘highly’.
